Faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before joining the partner program.
Faq.q1: How do I start as an IB or marketing partner?
Faq.a1: Create a free account in minutes. Once approved, you get an agent code and referral links you can share right away.
Faq.a2: We offer Revenue Share up to 60%, a fixed amount per qualified client (CPA), plus a multi-tier Sub-IB system.
Faq.q3: When and how do I receive my earnings?
Faq.a3: Your earnings accrue automatically in your wallet, and you can request withdrawals via bank transfer, crypto, or e-wallets — processed quickly and transparently.
Faq.q4: How do I track my referral performance?
Faq.a4: From the dashboard you track clicks, signups, trading volume, and earnings per campaign through live charts and detailed tables.
Faq.a5: Yes. We enforce strict row-level security (RLS) in the database, so your data is isolated and only you can access it.
